h1: Pricing insights built from your own sales data
overview: Pricing is often a guess. You send us a sales export and your costs, and we look at margins, discounts, price changes and how each product sold afterwards. The report points out products priced below what shoppers seem willing to pay, items where discounts did not help and gaps between your own ranges. We use your data and public prices you supply, with no scraping of private sites.
